name: LightPillar-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Tall bright violet pillar with a clear wavy white core and wide side glow.

tagline: A violet pillar of light shimmers up a dark stage.
summary: A tall column of violet light rises from the middle of a black stage, with a white-hot wavy core and a soft glow spreading sideways. It shimmers and turns slowly without ever breaking apart.
appearance: A tall column of violet light rises through the middle of a near-black stage, brightest at the centre and fading outward into soft pink haze. A jagged white filament runs up the spine of the pillar.
behaviour: The column breathes and shimmers, the inner filament writhing while the glow around it slowly turns. The pillar sways gently but never breaks apart.
demo_content: A single violet light pillar on black at default colours and quality.
search_phrases: glowing beam rising from the floor
purple laser pillar for a hero
light beam with a glowing core
use_when: A dark page wants one commanding vertical light behind a title or product shot.
avoid_when: A narrow bright column pulls the eye and fights text placed over it without a scrim.
customise: Top and bottom colours, intensity, rotation speed, glow, pillar width and height, noise and quality are props; the ray-marched shape is fixed.
weight_why: A ray-marched shader with up to 80 iterations per pixel on every frame.

a11y.note: A canvas backdrop with no labels; its endless shimmer ignores reduced-motion settings.

polish_why: Strong, convincing light column with a hot core; the glow is soft and the palette reads well.
title: Light Pillar
